about_the_game:
Motorcycle Ride: Infinity – Music On. Throttle Open. Ride Without Limits.

Motorcycle Ride: Infinity is all about the simple joy of riding. No finish lines. No complicated mechanics. Just an endless, straight highway stretching ahead and the freedom to ride as long as you want.

Turn up your music, grip the throttle, and lose yourself in motion. With flowing traffic and an open road, every moment is about the experience—not the destination.

  • Endless straight highway – One infinite road with smooth pacing and light traffic to keep the world alive.

  • Bring your own soundtrack – Play your favorite music in the background to match your mood.

  • Simple and responsive controls – Jump in and ride with ease—no tutorials needed.

  • Track your distance – Watch the kilometers stack up and enjoy your personal ride progress.

  • Collide and restart – Crashes reset the ride. Mistakes are part of the experience—just jump back in and go again.

  • Freedom to ride – No goals. No timers. Just the road, the sound of your engine, and your own pace.

Motorcycle Ride: Infinity is in early development. It currently features one bike and a single infinite road, with a focus on clean, uninterrupted riding.

Future updates will expand and polish the experience—but at its core, it will always be about one thing: riding freely, without limits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 @ 2.8 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
